title: 2140 Prairie's tall chimney brought down to its photographs
items: The Tucker/Smith house at 2140 Prairie now has its tall chimney with four pots at the height two old photographs show. It had stood about 1.5 m too tall, and it has moved about half a metre to where both pictures place it.

Both photographs, taken from the corner of Prairie and 22nd Street, are now matched against the house. The comparison shows what is still wrong: the round tower should stand right at the corner, and the towers' caps, the dormers and the iron fence still need work.
